learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialization, at the level necessary to acquire the rest of the degree competencies, including notions of the latest advances.
Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Engineering analysis: The ability to analyze complex products, processes and systems in their field of study; choose and apply established analytical, calculation and experimental methods appropriately and correctly interpret the results of said analyses.

Engineering analysis: The ability to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems in their specialty; appropriately choose and apply established analytical, calculation and experimental methods; recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial constraints.

Engineering projects: Ability to design, plan and develop complex products (parts, components, finished products, etc.), processes and systems in their specialty, that comply with established requirements, including awareness of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial aspects; as well as selecting and applying appropriate project methods.
Engineering projects: Design ability using some cutting-edge knowledge of their engineering specialty.

Research and innovation: Ability to perform bibliographic searches, consult and critically use databases and other sources of information, to carry out simulation and analysis with the aim of conducting research on technical topics in their specialty.
Research and innovation: Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Research and innovation: Ability and skill to design and carry out experimental investigations, interpret results and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, design and research and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects and conduct research specific to their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial implications of engineering practice.
Judgment making: Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams and to cooperate with engineers and people from other disciplines.
Continuous training: Ability to recognize the need for their own continuous training and to undertake this activity throughout their professional life independently.
Continuous training: Ability to stay up-to-date with developments in science and technology.
Define the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, arguing and justifying each of them, and making correct use of language, in writing.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to heat transfer: Conduction, Convection and Radiation
Solutions to the heat diffusion equation
Methodological training on problem-solving and communication
teaching_methods: Development, writing, and presentation of reports, memoranda, and audiovisual material related to projects/POPBLs (individual or team work)
Individual study and work, including preparation for tests and exams
Participatory classes with teacher presentations of concepts and procedures

assessment_methods.method: Technical capacity, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation submitted, technical presentation and defense
Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject

assessment_rules: The semester project evaluation is continuous and based on meetings between teams and tutors/experts. A week before the final report submission, the work will be analyzed to identify areas for improvement and communicate them to the team. The final version of the report with corrected improvements will serve as the resit. For individual technical competencies, written and oral individual tests are used for evaluation. The recovery mechanism for these is also individual written and oral tests.
